page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; margin notes in the right margin. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: opus esse videretur. Gaudebat quippe utraque pars fœdere, ejusque fructu suaviter afficiebatur. Itaque data utrimque opera est, ut ampliatum rebus & tempore denuò feriretur. Idque confectum exeunte anno M. CCCC. LXXXII, triduò anteFœdus po- natalem Domini: tempus ei decretumstremum superiore majus. Ejus capita præcipuacum vici- fuére hæc, ut sunt in Historiâ à me expressa: Pax inter partes esset, salvo cuique legitimo jure suo; auxiliis se mutuò juvarent, si res auxiliis egeret; temerè nemo in exilium pelleretur, nisi criminum gravium reus, & contumax: ex legibus sese mutuò convenirent, omni vi missâ: Principes externos, & quoscunque alios vim sociis afferentes, aut libertatem prementes communi operâ pro viribus arcerent: postulati auxilia ferrent ad arbitrium bonorum virorum, & statim, & suis sumptibus; cessantesq; in hoc officio ꝓM[?]. scutatos veteres in usum apparatus bellici penderent: tumultuantes comprimerentur maturè: si qui turbatâ pace publicâ ceperint alios, ac spoliarint, captos dimitterent confestim, spolioque duplicitèr restituto insuper gravem multam fœderinis in A-gro,& e:leberrimû.

page.notes: The right-margin notes are printed in four lines, set beside the text lines; they are placed where they stand and read together as: "Fœdus postremum cum vicinis in A-gro, & celeberrimû." The "e:" in the note is printed with a colon, possibly an e- hyphen; left as printed. The reference-like sign before "M." in "officio ꝓM[?]." is unclear. The word "statim" and other long-s forms are written with plain s. Printed hyphens kept on note words.
